column1: # A hand-made timings file for scripts/tests/run.sh. NOT a snapshot of the real suite: seven durations
# chosen so the greedy split has one obvious answer and the report's numbers can be checked by eye.
# 70 is a deliberate echo of the real floor — one test longer than every other put together, so no
# assignment can even the shards out and the report has to say so.
# `absent_from_the_binary` is here and NOT in tests.list: a recorded duration for a test that no longer
# exists is one of the two drift directions shard-plan reports, and the one that is easy to leave rotting.
